ops.why: Weakest entry at cap: it instructs dispatching distillation to a member, and the orchestrator has no member path; displaced by P-17.

ops.entry: WHEN validation has passed and a pull request is next DO run every CI check step in a fresh clone with a scrubbed environment — the validate matrix is not the CI step list, so an audit no validator ran reddens the pull request instead.
ops.why: One observation: a local clean-clone run of all CI steps caught reader-inventory drift three validate rounds never executed.

originals.original: WHEN dispatching distillation to a member DO hand it the paths to its own prior artifacts and say self-derived candidates count as its own material. Without that, every entry in its file traces to your relay and the acceptance rate grades your dispatch rather than its judgement.

ops.entry: WHEN a plan run returns pending DO read every panel finding's disposition before returning the plan for signature — pm can apply the findings and leave them all open, and an open high finding makes the plan unsignable without an overrule.
ops.why: One observation: seven dispositions, one high, were left open after the findings were applied; the plan-phase reference does not mention dispositions.
